generations.prompt: Inside a small candlelit upstairs room at night: a young woman in a white linen chemise and a bearded man in an open white linen shirt sit close together on the edge of a straw bed, a jester's tunic with bells thrown over its foot, a casement window open to the moonlight at the left, a heavy plank door at the right. He glances at the door, springs up from the bed, snatches his boots from the floor and crosses to the open window; he swings one leg over the sill, looks back at her with a grin, and drops out of sight into the night; she rises and hurries to the window after him and leans out. Camera static. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
